messages:
Maya: Quick prefight check — we're merging release/v2.14.0 -> main today. Can folks confirm green on lint, e2e-smoke, and the two flaky suspects? Planning to cut at 16:00 PT unless something blocks.

Chris: Which PR is the merge for? link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/compare/release/v2.14.0...main

Maya: It's PR #4921 (release: v2.14.0). I pushed the version bump branch earlier.

Sarah: CI dashboard: https://ci.redwood.internal/pipelines/4921 — current failures are on mac-12 and a single e2e job. Failing tests: `tests/storage/test_shard_rotation::test_gc_timing` and `tests/serving/test_streaming_fallback.py::test_kv_cache_restore`.

Kevin: I repro'd the shard_rotation locally on macos-latest with `pytest tests/storage/test_shard_rotation::test_gc_timing -k shard` — looks like a timing race under load.

Tom: I can queue a rerun for the flaky e2e, but if shard_rotation is real we might need an xfail for mac until we fix. Want me to open a tiny PR?

Chris: Please don't xfail lightly. If it's mac-only we can guard with `@pytest.mark.skipif(sys.platform == \"darwin\", reason=\"timing-dependent\")` and add a TODO with an issue link. Snippet: ```python
import sys
import pytest

@pytest.mark.skipif(sys.platform == \"darwin\", reason=\"timing flake on macos — see #5032\")
def test_gc_timing():
    ...
```

Maya: That approach sounds fine for cutoff. Also reminder: add a single-line entry to CHANGELOG.md under Unreleased for the feature flag changes. PRs without changelog lines will be held.

Sarah: I opened a quick fix PR that adds the skip and a regression test: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/5033 — includes the issue link to #5032. CI rerun triggered.

deploy-bot: Rerun queued for pipeline 4921 by Tom. Job ids: build-4921-34, e2e-4921-12. ETA ~7m.

Tom: Also pinging owners: @Kevin for storage flakes, @Chris for serving fallback, can you both take a look?

Kevin: On it. I'll try to repro under stress harness and post logs. If we can't stabilize in 90m, we should opt for the skip for this release.

Chris: I'll verify the kv cache restore failure — looks like a rare order-of-ops on fallback path. If I can add an assertion guard rather than skip, I'll PR today.

Maya: Thanks. If we end up skipping, make sure PR description mentions it's a temporary release-only skip and link to the follow-up issue. Also include changelog entry for the bump: `v2.14.0 — minor: binary protocol improvements (internal)`.

Sarah: CI: build-4921-34 passed, e2e-4921-12 failed again but different test: `tests/cli/test_config_reload.py::test_reload_signal`. Looks like flakiness is spreading, investigating.

Kevin: Hm. Could be concurrency in test env. I'm going to run the stress suite with `tox -e stress` and attach logs.

Tom: If the flaky surface is growing, we should consider holding the release for a short patch window. What's the ETA on your stress run, Kevin?

Kevin: ~25m for a good sample. I'll drop results here.

Maya: Plan: hold merge until 16:00 PT. If we have stable green on the critical pipelines (lint, build, core e2e) by then, we'll proceed and apply targeted skips for mac-only flakes with PRs linking issues. If unstable, postpone and iterate.

Chris: Ack. I'll triage the kv cache issue first.

Sarah: I'll keep rerunning the failing e2e and collect failure traces. If anyone needs access to the CI debug runs, ping me.

Tom: I'll queue up the changelog PR template and reminder message for the release notes thread.

deploy-bot: Notification: release cut-off scheduled at 16:00 PT. Auto-reminder will post 30m prior.

Maya: Thanks team — please update this thread with any blocker/status changes. :thumbsup:
